need: The file names a maker, a clerk and a buyer. Three people can honestly call this the first copy.

routes.action: Start where the materials came from
routes.returnLine: We can place the earliest layer. A name has still to be earned.

routes.action: Start where the first signature appears
routes.returnLine: We know who signed. I have left the earlier hand its own space.

need: The maker wants a trial in front of the queue. The usher worries the far end will see only the applause.

routes.action: Move the equipment into the square
routes.returnLine: Four visitors repeated the trial. The evening delivery had to wait.

routes.action: Set up a second viewing position
routes.returnLine: The last person in line could finally see what I was pointing at.

need: Two witnesses held the lamp at different times. Each took home a different shadow.

routes.action: Reconstruct the first witness’s angle
routes.returnLine: We can make that shadow again. There is still room for a second account.

routes.action: Follow the witness who came back at dusk
routes.returnLine: The later light changed the mark. The morning witness believed what they saw.

need: The cabinet is too tall for someone sitting down. That person is the only visitor who recognises the mark.

routes.action: Rehang the lights
routes.returnLine: The old case stayed in service. We rewired it for a seated reader.

routes.action: Build a mount that turns
routes.returnLine: The next visitor turned the mount themselves. The keeper had to catch the hinge.

need: The agent can put one sheet on the first boat. Three families expect a decision before evening.

routes.action: Send a qualified working copy
routes.returnLine: They could act today. The agent agreed to fetch us if the condition failed.

routes.action: Buy a second slot by running the stall
routes.returnLine: Both sheets went. We gave the trader a shift of work in exchange.

need: A Warden can correct the record quietly. The person who relied on it must still find out what changed.

routes.action: Deliver a correction to the first household
routes.returnLine: I heard it from a person before I saw the new notice.

routes.action: Hinge the old wording under the new
routes.returnLine: I can see what changed without asking anyone to confess.

need: The circle wants the working materials laid out. A name on one of the slips was given in confidence.

routes.action: Make a public band of the independent traces
routes.returnLine: People could pull on the source threads. The private name stayed folded.

routes.action: Give the consenting witness the public seat
routes.returnLine: They said only what they had agreed to share. The questions went to them.

need: The last stamp bought a quicker passage. Its owner denies paying for the first one.

routes.action: Count back through the stamped bundles
routes.returnLine: The total ends at the agent’s desk. The first payment is still unsigned.

routes.action: Try the seal in the original clasp
routes.returnLine: The notch fitted two handles. The stamp can travel further than its owner.

need: Half the chorus remembers a pause. The other half remembers a note. Both can guide the next crew home.

routes.action: Rehearse the pause
routes.returnLine: The rest let the boat complete its turn before the call.

routes.action: Lift the changed pin from the tune
routes.returnLine: The returning bar was once a different pitch. We kept both versions.

need: The chart and the ground agree on the chapel. Beyond the bend they seem to describe different shores.

routes.action: Survey the shore from overhead
routes.returnLine: We matched the roofs. The river has been busy since the first drawing.

routes.action: Measure along the bank with the porter
routes.returnLine: The extra bend cost the cart half a turn. The old route made sense on foot.

need: The meeting has one open chair. People at both ends want the Guardian to speak first.

routes.action: Put both accounts on the same wall
routes.returnLine: Nobody needed the chair to see the disagreement. We still had to give someone the floor.

routes.action: Ask the audience to test the claim aloud
routes.returnLine: A visitor took the chair and qualified the claim. The crowd stayed to hear it.

need: The keeper leaves an empty space in the plan. Someone new to this room might see a way the staff have missed.

routes.action: Co-design a signal with the next visitor
routes.returnLine: The visitor taught the signal back to us. We will have to ask newcomers how it reads.

routes.action: Turn the unfamiliar glass yourself
routes.returnLine: The unusual light disclosed another edge. We left the lens where the next visitor could move it.
